Summaries.eng: New director of a supernatural department, Xuan Ji meets thousand-year-old Sheng Lingyuan, an encounter that leads to a bigger conspiracy.
Summaries.jpn: 赤淵の炎に飛びこんだ人間界の皇帝・盛霊淵は、悠久の時を経て、何者かの千霊法陣という術で現代へと呼び覚まされた。一方、特殊能力者の自治組織である異対センターに就職した赤淵の炎の守護者・宣璣は、初日から盛霊淵の復活事件を担当することに…。

Summaries.eng: A group of backpackers was attacked by strange things in a restricted area. Xuan Ji, who just joined the Center dealing with supernaturals, was put in charge of the case. As he's investigating, he found out forbidden arts were used to summon a demon.
Summaries.jpn: 原生林が茂る景観地区・赤淵で突然、大樹が観光客を襲う事件が発生。宣璣は異常現象・特殊個体対策センターの職務に就いて早々、赤淵へ向かうよう指示を受ける。

Summaries.eng: Summoning a demon demands a sacrifice of 1000 people within a month, and the Center only have a few hours to stop the spell from completion. They raced against the clock to locate the mastermind behind the spell. However...
Summaries.jpn: 人魔・盛霊淵が現れたのは、千人の生霊で魔物を召喚する禁断の術・千霊法陣による可能性が高いと肖征に伝える宣璣。しかし法陣の完成時刻は今夜に迫っていた。

Summaries.eng: The mastermind succeeded in summoning the demon and tries to expose the Center's shady past. It turns out some people in the Center have been covering up civilian deaths by infecting them with a parasite that turns them into the living dead.
Summaries.jpn: 千霊法陣の完成により、力が解き放たれた盛霊淵は忽然と姿を消す。一方宣璣は、狙撃された男は人魔の召喚者ではないと推理する。真の召喚者は一体誰なのか。

Summaries.eng: The demon was seemingly annihilated, only to turn up inside Xuan Ji's sword. Meanwhile, Xuan Ji and his team went to investigate the lead on a mutated version of the Illusory Butterfly that is much more lethal.
Summaries.jpn: 契約を反故にした盛霊淵に陣の力が直撃し...。後日、少年の体から分離した鏡花水月蝶が変異種と判明し、宣璣は季清晨が変異種を入手した場所を探りに東州へ赴く。

Summaries.eng: Xuan Ji was teleported to an ancient tomb that houses thousands of the mutated butterflies. Meanwhile, the Center is under fire for the scandal and other organizations are demanding for independent investigation and supervision of the Center.
Summaries.jpn: 暗黒の空間に引きずり込まれた宣璣と盛霊淵。盛霊淵の制止を聞かずに入った洞窟を抜けるとそこは宗祠の中心で、宣璣は棺の周囲に千霊法陣らしきものを発見する。

Summaries.eng: A second demon was summoned in the tomb, and it appears to be an old acquaintance of Sheng Lingyuan. Sheng Lingyuan was hit with a spell that forces him to relive his past from 3000 years prior, and Xuan Ji was dragged along into it.
Summaries.jpn: 兀族の術で肉体が蘇った盛霊淵。洞窟内に響きわたる盛霊淵と阿洛津の会話から宣璣はその正体を予想するが、術により盛霊淵と共に記憶の渦に入り込んでしまい...。

Summaries.eng: 3000 years ago, Sheng Lingyuan was a young prince that was hunted by the fiends. In his most desperate moment, he was rescued by the Wu people living in Dongzhou, and there he met the young Aluojin. Thus begun their friendship and eventual falling out...
Summaries.jpn: 秘術遡洄により兀族滅亡までの記憶をたどる宣璣と人皇・盛霊淵。盛霊淵と彼を慕う阿洛津は兀族が暮らす東州を離れて共闘するが、ある事件が大きな悲劇へ繋がる。

Summaries.eng: As more of Sheng Lingyuan's past was revealed, the truth behind the tragedy 3000 years prior was laid bare.
Summaries.jpn: 盛霊淵が到着した時には悪呪により大量の人面蝶が兀族の人々の体を乗っ取っていた。自らの師である丹離が放った火に焼かれる兀族を目の当たりにし、盛霊淵は...。

Summaries.eng: Aeolus arrived as back up to the Aftermath Response Team, and together they managed to locate Xuan Ji. However, they were ambushed by Elder Yuede's forces, and the attack blew apart the hill and released thousands of mutated butterflies into open air.
Summaries.jpn: 月徳公の指令を受けた者たちが開発段階の破壊兵器で証拠隠滅を図った砲撃の反動で、井戸に落ちてしまった楊潮。落ちた先は宣璣や盛霊淵がいる地下空間だった。

Summaries.eng: Xuan Ji and Sheng Lingyuan's minds were linked again, and he found out that Lingyuan knows something about his past. Meanwhile, Aluojin's seal was broken again by the mastermind, and Aluojin is now hellbent on killing Xuan Ji, the Firekeeper of Chiyuan.
Summaries.jpn: 宣璣の記憶に入り込む盛霊淵だが、会話は不愉快に終始する。一方、兀人宗の跡地では阿洛津の眠る棺が跡形もなく消失したうえ、現場に現像術が施されていて...。

Summaries.eng: While Xuan Ji and Aeolus are luring Aluojin away from the urban area, a spell left by Sheng Lingyuan in the tomb was triggered, activating a lightning spell that will strike the mastermind. However, the mastermind has possessed Xiao Zheng's body...
Summaries.jpn: 黒幕の手で目覚めホテルまで追ってきた阿洛津は、南明の由来や宣璣が何者であるかを明かす。その頃、盛霊淵はホテルで警察に不審人物と見なされ包囲されていた。

Summaries.eng: The mastermind's plan was stopped, but it was only a double that the Lightning spell destroyed. Xuan Ji suspects that there are moles within the Center. Meanwhile, Xuan Ji needs to decide on what to do with Sheng Lingyuan.
Summaries.jpn: 陣の拘束を逃れた阿洛津は宣璣を攻撃するが、盛霊淵が身を挺してかばう。ダメージが残る盛霊淵を連れてホテルへと戻った宣璣は盛霊淵の髪を洗ってやることに。
